name: llm-wiki
description: Local-first Agent Skills package for source-cited Obsidian knowledge bases, with Codex and Claude Code adapters. Includes explicit vault setup, recoverable transactions, provenance, lint, and retrieval. User vaults stay outside the plugin cache; network and destructive actions require explicit consent.

interface.shortDescription: Build and query a source-cited Obsidian knowledge base.
defaultPrompt: Use the wiki skill in llm-wiki to set up a separate knowledge vault.
Use the wiki-query skill in llm-wiki to answer from my vault.
